verdict.rationale: Lambda publishes its own API reference site (docs-api.lambda.ai/api/cloud, with endpoint entries such as "List workspaces" and "Create workspace"). It also serves a full OpenAPI 3.1 spec for the Lambda Cloud API without a key, so a structured reference exists. Nothing in the evidence shows that the reference is interactive or offers runnable or try-it examples, and the probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI at the docs domain returned 404s. missing for 10: evidence of interactive try-it/console functionality, runnable code examples in the reference, independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The Lambda Cloud API provides a set of REST API endpoints you can use to create and manage your Lambda Cloud resources.
https://cloud.lambda.ai/api/v1/openapi.json serves the full Lambda Cloud API OpenAPI 3.1 spec
